test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A man sold his bike for Rs. 18,600 at 55% profit. At what price would he have sold to incur a loss of 10%?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the bike = Rs.18,600

Profit earned by man = 55%

**Formula used:**

Profit percent = Profit/Cost price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the bike be 100x.

When a man got 55% profit on selling

Then, the Selling price of the bike = 100x + 55x 

= 155x

According to the question,

⇒ 155x = 18600
